en: A postcard reproducing the front page of an old Portuguese newspaper titled "O COMBATE". The layout is densely packed text in columns with a bold masthead at the top. Beneath the title, there is a line naming the proprietor and director, Daniel de Lima Trindade, and a dateline indicating Lisbon on Monday, 8 May 1882. The central feature is a decorative double oval portrait framed with ornate foliage, showing two 18th‑century figures in wigs and formal attire, labeled as Dom José I and Marquez de Pombal. The rest of the page is filled with long articles in Portuguese, commemorating Sebastião José de Carvalho e Mello.
